title: Design a notification service under three hard constraints

requirements.text: architecture.json is valid and has every required top-level key
Components: at least three, unique ids, real responsibilities, acyclic dependencies
Every requirement R1-R8 of the brief is mapped to existing components, consistently in both places
Every constraint C1-C3 has a written explanation
Interfaces name provider, consumers, input, output and at least one error
Decisions list at least two options, a chosen one, rationale, trade-offs and a revisit condition
Risks have a mitigation and a way to validate
The chosen technologies respect the constraints (no extra datastore, broker or orchestrator)
DESIGN.md has the required sections and refers to every requirement and constraint by id
